products: Data + AI platform (Lakehouse) unifying analytics, warehousing, governance, and generative AI. Flagship products include Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, Databricks Apps, Lakebase (serverless Postgres), Genie, and Agent Bricks for enterprise agents on customer data.
fiscal_outlook: Private; LinkedIn and company materials cite ~$2.6B annual revenue and ~$27B total funding historically. Late-2025 public signals referenced >$4.8B revenue run-rate, >55% YoY growth, and a large Series L raise at a ~$134B valuation—treat run-rate/valuation as company-reported, not audited here.
hiring_trends: Heavy eng hiring across Staff frontend/fullstack, AI-native web platform, agentic internal apps, and data/AI infrastructure. Expanding Seattle/Bellevue and Vancouver R&D; Denver appears on some G&A postings. Themes: React/TypeScript product UI, LLM/agent platforms, and lakehouse infra.
similar_role_hires: Live careers postings include Staff Frontend (Seattle), Staff Frontend (NYC vertical AI apps), Staff AI-Native Web Platform (Mountain View), Staff/Sr. Staff Fullstack Agentic Applications (Mountain View), and Senior Fullstack (Seattle).
hiring_profile: Official Greenhouse-backed careers pages with deep JDs and published pay bands. Most Staff product roles are office-tied (SF Bay, Seattle, NYC, Vancouver)—not remote-first. Strong seniority bar (often 8–12+ years). Prefer databricks.com job URLs; IDs can rotate.
